title: Maintenance Medication Terms by Network (Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit)
content:
Each network of the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit sets a maintenance-medication rule for retail fills, the number of 30-day retail fills of the same maintenance drug allowed per plan year before that rule applies (the courtesy fills), what the member pays on a 30-day maintenance fill after the courtesy fills, and whether the member may opt out.

| | Northbridge Performance Network | Northbridge Essential Network | Northbridge National Network | Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | Northbridge Retail90 Network | Northbridge Open Choice Network |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Maintenance rule | Mandatory after courtesy fills | Mandatory after courtesy fills | Mandatory after courtesy fills | None | 90 days at retail or home delivery | None |
| Courtesy 30-day fills per plan year | 2 | 2 | 3 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| Charge on a 30-day maintenance fill after the courtesy fills | Full cost | Full cost | Double copay | None | Reject | None |
| Member may opt out of the maintenance rule | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |

## Meaning of the entries

- **Mandatory after courtesy fills**: after the courtesy fills, a 30-day retail fill of a maintenance drug carries the network's maintenance charge.
- **90 days at retail or home delivery**: after the courtesy fills, a maintenance drug must be filled as 90 days at retail or by home delivery.
- **None** (rule): no maintenance rule applies; the courtesy-fill figure is 0.
- **Full cost**: the member pays the full allowed amount, not counted toward deductible or out-of-pocket.
- **Double copay**: twice the 30-day cost share.
- **Reject**: the claim rejects and must be filled as 90 days at retail or by home delivery.
- **Opt out**: the member may elect to keep filling 30-day maintenance supplies at retail at the normal cost share by recording an opt-out choice.

## Maintenance medications (all six networks)

The same list, drawn from the Northbridge Rx drug master list, applies on every network: atorvastatin, lisinopril, metformin, sertraline, levothyroxine, insulin glargine-yfgn, Lantus, Eliquis, Xarelto, Jardiance, Ozempic, Mounjaro, Trelegy Ellipta and Breztri Aerosphere.
